title: Scottsdale Oasis | Pickeball | Pool | Golf Sim
description: Welcome to your Scottsdale oasis! Our cheery 6BR/3BA retreat is built for fun. Jump into the pool, relax in the spa, or challenge friends to pickleball, golf, and putting—all in your massive backyard! The separate game house is packed with hits, while an outdoor kitchen awaits your BBQ. Just minutes from world-class shopping and top-tier entertainment, we’re perfectly placed for your AZ adventure. Come make memories in the sun!
amenities: Housekeeping available Monday to Friday - available at extra cost
Pack ’n play/Travel crib - available upon request
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability
Well equipped!  Great staff! Great location!  Awesome!  Planning to do it again.

The place felt like a mini resort with so much to do for our group. Kids and adults enjoyed the pool and the games in the casita. Everything is easy to find as it labeled. Will look forward to book this place again

Great place to stay, plenty of beds to go around, had 8 people stay and we had plenty of room for more. Great space use with all the activities to do. Found ourselves at dinner excited to head back and hang out in the space provided. So much fun over all! Wish we were there for more time. Would love to stay again!
Great stay for large group. Waterslide was our favorite part about the house, and multiple towels and blankets for everyone
